issues.reason: The repository contains a pinned secondary transcription and current official overlays, but not the primary Codex cards needed for field-by-field baseline parity.
The card is not reprinted in Faction Pack v1.1; the official Codex title is required.

The local TARGET identifies the disembarked ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit, while Wahapedia associates the Stratagem with the TRANSPORT. The primary Codex card must decide which entity the datasheet lookup should focus on.
The local TARGET allows an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit and uses BATTLELINE only for an optional relay, but Wahapedia omits these two BATTLELINE datasheets. The primary Codex card is required.
